results.question:
Show a bar chart of stock on hand for category Apparel grouped by product.
Required dashboard date/filter scope: Category Apparel only, grouped by product_id

payload.sql: SELECT p.product_id, SUM(i.stock_on_hand) AS stock_on_hand FROM commerce.inventory i JOIN commerce.products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.category=$1 GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10

filters: Category Apparel only, grouped by product_id
